display_name: Sher Shah Suri & Khawas Khan Marwat
one_line: Afghan Sur emperor Sher Shah Suri and his trusted general Khawas Khan Marwat in the turbulent 1540–1554 CE politics of North India.

appearance.age_look: Sher Shah appears as a broad-shouldered man in his late 40s; Khawas Khan as a lean, athletic man in his mid-30s.
appearance.face: Sher Shah has a square face, wheatish North Indian-Afghan complexion, strong jaw, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes with a calm but commanding expression; Khawas Khan has an oval face, slightly deeper complexion, narrow intense eyes, trimmed moustache and very short beard, usually wearing a focused, alert look.
appearance.hair: Sher Shah’s hair is black with a few subtle grey streaks, kept short and hidden under a rich dark green Afghan-style turban wrapped close to the head with a narrow tail draped over one shoulder; Khawas Khan’s straight black hair is cropped short and covered by a simpler dark maroon turban tied lower on the forehead, with a small knot at the back.
appearance.costume: Sher Shah wears a long, modest quilted cotton jama reaching to mid-calf in deep bottle green with subtle vertical stitching, a wide golden-ochre woven sash tied firmly at the waist, cream churidar-style fitted trousers, and sturdy brown leather boots; over the jama he has a sleeveless, waist-length padded vest in muted brown for light armour, and a simple dark green shawl edge draped over one shoulder; Khawas Khan wears a practical knee-length jama in deep maroon with a faint diagonal weave, a dark olive sash at the waist, beige fitted trousers, soft dark brown leather boots, and a slightly shorter sleeveless padded coat in dull steel-grey over his torso, with a plain dark olive shawl folded and slung across his back for utility.
appearance.signature: Sher Shah carries a sheathed curved talwar with a simple steel hilt and dark brown leather scabbard hanging from his golden-ochre sash, while Khawas Khan carries a long straight Afghan-style spear with a leaf-shaped steel head and a dark wooden shaft held upright in his right hand.

ref_desc: Sher Shah Suri has a square, bearded face, short black hair under a dark green turban, a deep green quilted jama with golden-ochre sash and talwar, while Khawas Khan Marwat is lean with maroon turban, maroon jama, grey padded coat and a long spear, using greens, maroon, cream and brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw two full-body anime-style historical Afghan figures standing side by side: Sher Shah Suri and Khawas Khan Marwat. Sher Shah is broad-shouldered, late-40s, with a square wheatish face, sharp dark eyes, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, and short black hair edged with a bit of grey, all covered by a close-wrapped dark green Afghan-style turban whose narrow tail falls over his shoulder. He wears a long deep bottle-green quilted cotton jama to mid-calf with visible vertical stitching, tied with a wide golden-ochre woven sash at the waist, cream fitted churidar trousers, and sturdy dark brown leather boots; over his torso sits a simple sleeveless waist-length padded vest in muted brown, and a dark green shawl edge drapes over one shoulder. At his left hip hangs his signature curved talwar in a dark brown leather scabbard with a plain steel hilt. Beside him, Khawas Khan Marwat is lean and athletic, mid-30s, with an oval slightly deeper complexion, narrow intense eyes, very short beard and moustache, and cropped straight black hair under a simpler dark maroon turban tied lower on the forehead with a small knot at the back. He wears a practical knee-length maroon jama with a faint diagonal weave, a dark olive sash, beige fitted trousers, and soft dark brown leather boots; over his torso is a slightly shorter sleeveless padded coat in dull steel-grey, and a plain dark olive shawl is folded and slung across his back. His right hand grips his signature long straight Afghan-style spear, with a leaf-shaped steel head and dark wooden shaft held upright. Use a restrained historical palette dominated by deep bottle green, maroon, golden ochre, cream, dark olive and dark brown, keeping the scene family-safe, fully clothed and era-accurate, and present them front-facing as a clear model sheet with all costume and weapon details visible head to toe.
